snapshot.text: Compulsory social health insurance introduced in 2020 alongside a state-guaranteed basic package. The insurance package expanded in 2026, and the government plans to move health financing fully to an insurance model by 2027.

priorities.title: Wider insurance package
priorities.text: From 2026 the package covers more chronic conditions and kidney care, and low-income groups are insured.

priorities.title: Insurance for the unemployed
priorities.text: The state will fund health insurance for over a million unemployed citizens.

priorities.title: Higher pay for medical staff
priorities.text: Salaries of medical workers are to rise and their legal protection to be strengthened.
